reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low and I always forget pills at home, so a counted sachet I can toss in my bag is exactly my problem. The named lab and the batch report make me trust it more than a random TikTok bottle, and $24.99 for one box is an easy trial.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other brands put 8 forms in one capsule? I also have no idea if it is any better than a cheap bottle from the drugstore.
